prerequisites: Second study section achieved (at least 42 ECTS points from the first study section)
Proficient use of a presentation tool
Prior experience in lecture design and presentation

learning_outcomes.text: Independently acquire specialized technical knowledge (literature work, analysis, conclusions) and present it comprehensibly in an oral presentation using appropriate media.
Supplement their presentation with computer demonstrations depending on the audience.
Enhance their presentation with technical details depending on the audience, thereby motivating a technical discussion during or after the presentation.
Critically follow a technical presentation and professionally discuss the content with the presenter (strengthening communicative competence).
Provide helpful and fair feedback to the presenter after a presentation.
Utilize their interdisciplinary and communicative competencies for the design and presentation of a technical lecture.
Present the content of their presentation in the form of a short written elaboration.

syllabus_topics: Reading scientific literature and developing technical content
Presenting and discussing source code, software architectures, and software designs in technical lectures
Actively following technical lectures and contributing to technical discussions
Communicating technical and non-technical information clearly
Documenting technical aspects of a presentation in a structured manner
assessment_rules: The examination performance in this module is a seminar paper, which is a written assignment with an oral presentation. The written assignment should be 3000 to 6000 words (approx. 10 to 20 pages). Each participant will be assigned a topic at the beginning of the seminar and must conduct literature research, incorporating the findings into their presentation and written elaboration. Each participant must lead a 90-minute session, including a 45-minute presentation, demonstrations if applicable, and moderating a technical discussion.
